input: List all active guest profiles with their primary email and phone.
query: SELECT PId, FirstName, LastName, PrimaryEmail, PrimaryPhone FROM [dbo].[profiles] WHERE IsActive = 1;

input: Show the latest 50 hotel stay records including guest name, arrival, departure, and room number.
query: SELECT TOP 50 s.PMSSId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, s.ArrivalWhen, s.DepartureWhen, s.RoomNumber FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s JOIN [dbo].[profiles] p ON p.PId = s.ProfileId ORDER BY s.ArrivalWhen DESC;

input: Find all restaurant reservations for a given profile ID.
query: SELECT * FROM [dbo].[restaurantreservations] WHERE ProfileId = {{profile_id}} ORDER BY StartWhen DESC;

input: Get total spa spending per guest profile.
query: SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalSpaSpent FROM [dbo].[spabookings] GROUP BY ProfileId;

input: Which guests have booked a tennis or padel court in the last 30 days?
query: SELECT c.CBId, c.ProfileId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, c.CourtTypeDescription, c.StartWhen FROM [dbo].[courtbookings] c JOIN [dbo].[profiles] p ON p.PId = c.ProfileId WHERE c.StartWhen >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE());

input: Show the top 20 guests by total restaurant spending.
query: SELECT TOP 20 ProfileId, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS RestaurantTotal FROM [dbo].[restaurantreservations] GROUP BY ProfileId ORDER BY RestaurantTotal DESC;

input: Find all spa bookings that were cancelled and show cancellation fees.
query: SELECT SBId, ProfileId, StartWhen, CancellationNumber, CAST(CancellationFee AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS CancelFee FROM [dbo].[spabookings] WHERE IsCancelled = 1;

input: Show all tee-time bookings with number of players and course name for the last 7 days.
query: SELECT TTBId, ProfileId, CourseName, NumberOfPlayers, BookedDate FROM [dbo].[teetimebookings] WHERE BookedDate >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE());

input: Get monthly revenue by revenue type for a given year.
query: SELECT Month, SUM(CAST(Revenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue, RevenueType FROM [dbo].[profilemonthlyspend] WHERE Year = {{year}} GROUP BY Month, RevenueType ORDER BY Month;

input: Which guests have checked in to any activity (spa, court, lesson) today?
query: SELECT ProfileId, 'spa' AS Source FROM [dbo].[spabookings] WHERE CAST(StartWhen AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND IsCheckedIn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId, 'court' AS Source FROM [dbo].[courtbookings] WHERE CAST(StartWhen AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND IsCheckedIn = 1 UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId, 'lesson' AS Source FROM [dbo].[lessonbookings] WHERE CAST(StartWhen AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND IsCheckedIn = 1;

input: Show all pool and beach amenity reservations for cabanas.
query: SELECT PBARId, ProfileId, PoolBeachName, StartWhen, CompletesWhen, PriceQuoted FROM [dbo].[poolbeachamenityreservations] WHERE PBAType = 'CABANA';

input: List profiles with VIP status and their last visit date.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, p.VIPStatus, (SELECT MAX(s.ArrivalWhen) FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s WHERE s.ProfileId = p.PId) AS LastVisit FROM [dbo].[profiles] p WHERE p.IsVIP = 1;

input: Get total combined spending (spa + restaurant) for each profile.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, COALESCE(spa.SpaSpend,0) + COALESCE(rest.RestSpend,0) AS TotalSpend FROM [dbo].[profiles] p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS SpaSpend FROM [dbo].[spabookings] GROUP BY ProfileId) spa ON spa.ProfileId = p.PId LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS RestSpend FROM [dbo].[restaurantreservations] GROUP BY ProfileId) rest ON rest.ProfileId = p.PId;

input: Which guests have transportation reservations today?
query: SELECT ProfileId, Driver, Destination, NumberOfGuests, StartWhen FROM [dbo].[transportationreservations] WHERE CAST(StartWhen AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

input: Get activity count per guest across all activity tables.
query: SELECT ProfileId, COUNT(*) AS ActivityCount FROM (SELECT ProfileId FROM [dbo].[courtbookings] UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM [dbo].[lessonbookings] UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM [dbo].[teetimebookings] UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM [dbo].[spabookings] UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM [dbo].[otherreservations]) x GROUP BY ProfileId ORDER BY ActivityCount DESC;

input: Find guests who stayed in a room of type 'Suite' in the last 6 months.
query: SELECT s.PMSSId, s.ProfileId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, s.RoomType, s.ArrivalWhen FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s JOIN [dbo].[profiles] p ON p.PId = s.ProfileId WHERE s.RoomType LIKE '%Suite%' AND s.ArrivalWhen >= DATEADD(month, -6, GETDATE());

input: Show the most frequently reserved restaurants.
query: SELECT RestaurantName, COUNT(*) AS TotalReservations FROM [dbo].[restaurantreservations] GROUP BY RestaurantName ORDER BY TotalReservations DESC;

input: Get the number of visits per profile per year from visit history.
query: SELECT ProfileId, CAST(VisitCount AS BIGINT) AS TotalVisits FROM [dbo].[profilevisitsperyear];

input: List all lesson bookings with instructor name, lesson type, and guest name.
query: SELECT l.LBId, l.InstructorName, l.LessonType, p.FirstName, p.LastName, l.StartWhen FROM [dbo].[lessonbookings] l JOIN [dbo].[profiles] p ON p.PId = l.ProfileId;

input: Find guests who spent more than 5000 total in all categories combined.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, CAST(p.TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TotalSpent FROM [dbo].[profiles] p WHERE CAST(p.TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 5000;

input: Summarize this week’s occupancy and revenue.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalStays, SUM(CAST(TotalRevenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATEADD(wk, DATEDIFF(wk, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AND ArrivalWhen < DATEADD(wk, DATEDIFF(wk, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%Cancelled%' AND IsCancelled = 0;

input: What is today’s occupancy?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OccupiedRooms FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] WHERE CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(ArrivalWhen AS DATE) AND CAST(DepartureWhen AS DATE) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' AND IsCancelled = 0;

input: Show total hotel revenue for this week.
query: SELECT SUM(CAST(TotalRevenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATEADD(wk, DATEDIFF(wk, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AND ArrivalWhen < DATEADD(wk, DATEDIFF(wk, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0);

input: Which departments are over or under performing this month?
query: SELECT 'Spa' AS Department, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS Revenue FROM [dbo].[spabookings] WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Restaurant', SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM [dbo].[restaurantreservations] WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'CourtBookings', SUM(CAST(BookingSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM [dbo].[courtbookings] WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Lessons', SUM(CAST(LessonSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM [dbo].[lessonbookings] WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'TeeTime', SUM(CAST(BookingSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM [dbo].[teetimebookings] WHERE MONTH(BookedDate)=MONTH(GETDATE());

input: Show me the top customer segments by lifetime value.
query: SELECT TOP 10 PrimaryCountry AS Segment, COUNT(*) AS Guests, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS LifetimeValue FROM [dbo].[profiles] WHERE TotalSpent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PrimaryCountry ORDER BY LifetimeValue DESC;

input: What states are most frequent international guests coming from?
query: SELECT PrimaryState AS State, COUNT(*) AS GuestCount FROM [dbo].[profiles] WHERE PrimaryCountry <> 'UAE' AND PrimaryState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PrimaryState ORDER BY GuestCount DESC;

input: Show me trends in booking windows over the past year.
query: SELECT FORMAT(ArrivalWhen, 'yyyy-MM') AS Month, AVG(DATEDIFF(day, CreatedWhen, ArrivalWhen)) AS AvgBookingWindow FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATEADD(month, -12, GETDATE()) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' GROUP BY FORMAT(ArrivalWhen, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY Month;

input: Which days typically experience the most check-in?
query: SELECT DATENAME(weekday, ArrivalWhen) AS DayOfWeek, COUNT(*) AS CheckIns FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] WHERE StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' GROUP BY DATENAME(weekday, ArrivalWhen) ORDER BY CheckIns DESC;

input: List VIP guests who haven't returned in the last 12 months.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, p.VIPStatus, (SELECT MAX(s.ArrivalWhen) FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s WHERE s.ProfileId = p.PId) AS LastArrival FROM [dbo].[profiles] p WHERE p.IsVIP = 1 HAVING (SELECT MAX(s.ArrivalWhen) FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s WHERE s.ProfileId = p.PId) < DATEADD(month, -12, GETDATE()) OR (SELECT MAX(s.ArrivalWhen) FROM [dbo].[pmsstays] s WHERE s.ProfileId = p.PId) IS NULL;

input: Which spa treatments are most popular by guest demographic?
query: SELECT p.Gender, p.PrimaryCountry AS Country, s.ActivityName AS Treatment, COUNT(*) AS TotalBookings FROM [dbo].[spabookings] s JOIN [dbo].[profiles] p ON p.PId = s.ProfileId WHERE s.IsCancelled = 0 GROUP BY p.Gender, p.PrimaryCountry, s.ActivityName ORDER BY TotalBookings DESC;

input: What is the average spend per guest in the spa over the past 3 months?
query: SELECT AVG(GuestAvg) AS AvgSpendPerGuest FROM ( SELECT ProfileId, AVG(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS GuestAvg FROM [dbo].[spabookings] WHERE StartWhen >= DATEADD(month, -3, GETDATE()) AND IsCancelled = 0 GROUP BY ProfileId ) x;

input: Which tee times are in highest demand throughout the week?
query: SELECT DATENAME(weekday, BookedDate) AS Weekday, DATEPART(hour, BookedDate) AS Hour, COUNT(*) AS TotalBookings FROM [dbo].[teetimebookings] WHERE IsCancelled = 0 GROUP BY DATENAME(weekday, BookedDate), DATEPART(hour, BookedDate) ORDER BY TotalBookings DESC;
